Copilot · Guided Foundation · for sign-off

Save from the cards, and the check is an extra step

Two changes you asked for. Save as Foundation moves out of the chat and onto the bottom of the cards column, because what is being saved is the cards. And the consistency check no longer stands between the finished parts and the Save button: it is offered beside it, and you can save with or without it. The shots are taken from the running platform on Mobile; the right-hand ones are the same page with the new bar drawn in.

While the parts are still being agreed

Every part agreed, check not run

After the check, with one thing to look at

Saved

How it behaves

  • The bar is always there under the cards, so the place to save never moves. Before every part is agreed it is greyed and counts what is left; after, it lights.
  • Save does not wait for the check. The check is an extra step: run it, read the notes in the chat, fix a part from its card or from the note, and save when you are happy. Run it again after an edit if you want.
  • If a part is edited after the check ran, the bar says the check has not run on the text as it stands now, exactly as the chat does today, and still lets you save.
  • The chat keeps its own job: the questions, the drafts, and the check's notes. The one line it says when everything is agreed points to the bar on the left.
  • The to-do on the right shows Consistency check as Optional rather than a step to finish, and Save as Foundation as the last step.
  • Saving does what it does today: a Foundation deliverable, versioned, under Deliverables on the rail. Nothing stored changes shape.

Three things to confirm

  1. The bar as drawn: at the bottom of the cards column, one line of status on the left, the two buttons on the right, greyed until every part is agreed.
  2. Should saving also write these six parts into the plan's own Foundation page? Today it makes a deliverable only; the other Copilot flows (Analysis, Directions, Execution) write the plan when they finish. If yes, that is a bigger change and I would describe it before building.
  3. The saved state reads Edit a card to start v2. Today a saved flow is read-only, so a change means starting a new chat. Keep it that way for now, or let a card be edited after saving to begin the next version?

The amber banner on two of the shots is the test harness's stand-in model answering empty on one step; it is not part of the proposal.
